items.source: Uses of ResourcePatternHint in org.springframework.aot.hint

Support for registering the need for reflection, resources, java
serialization and proxies at runtime.
items.translation: 支持在运行时注册对反射、资源、Java 序列化及代理的需求。

items.source: Return the include patterns to use to identify the resources to match.
items.translation: 返回用于识别要匹配的资源包含模式。
